meta.vintage: Calendar years 2020–2023 (M-Lab's statistics API stopped in March 2024; 2023 lacks 21 days, mostly 29 Jan–15 Feb)
meta.title: Internet Upload Speed (M-Lab)
meta.valueLabel: Typical upload speed in M-Lab speed tests (geometric mean, Mbps)
meta.summary: Typical upload speed measured by M-Lab's open NDT speed test, in megabits per second: the geometric mean of the year's tests in the country. Upload matters for video calls, cloud backup and sending files, and lags download wherever cable and DSL dominate. Tests are run by people who choose to (M-Lab powers the speed test in Google Search), over whatever link and device they use — home Wi-Fi, mobile data, office networks — so this is the speed people experience, not the speed of the plans on sale. NDT measures a single connection to the nearest M-Lab server, which can be in another country; figures run well below multi-connection tests such as Speedtest and should not be compared with them. One randomly chosen test per IP address per day; a country-year needs at least 1,000 tests.
meta.method: Geometric mean over the calendar year of NDT upload tests (one random test per IP per day), pooled exactly from M-Lab's daily per-country log averages weighted by test counts.
